note: Framework taxonomy copied from NODE_TO_DIMENSIONS, NODE_TO_FACTORS and Y3172_PIPELINE_NODES. It is structure, not knowledge-base content. dimensions.json in this folder is an unmodified copy from the same commit.

nodes.SRC: Source. The source of data that can be used as input to the ML pipeline.
nodes.C: Collector. Collects data from one or more SRC nodes. May configure SRC nodes.
nodes.PP: Pre-processor. Cleans, transforms and prepares raw data for ML consumption.
nodes.M: Model. Where ML models are trained, validated and execute inference.
nodes.P: Policy. Enforces policies on ML output before distribution.
nodes.D: Distributor. Distributes the output of the ML model to one or more SINK nodes.
nodes.SINK: Target of ML output. Where inference results are applied.
nodes.MLFO: ML Function Orchestrator. A logical node that manages and orchestrates the pipeline nodes.
nodes.Sandbox: ML Sandbox. A validation environment for testing models on simulated underlay networks.
